== buffer.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "unity-gain buffer around the OTA"
  vsym e20aa06947085fce
  vsch 24ce480743adfb22
  vcdf e20aa06947085fce
  vcdfrec "(\"cdf\" \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"size\" \"string\" \"1\" \"size\" \"\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"auCdl\" ((\"instParameters\" (\"size\")) (\"namePrefix\" \"X\") (\"netlistProcedure\" \"ansCdlSubcktCall\") (\"termOrder\" (\"IN\" \"OUT\" \"IB\"))))"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"spectre\" ((\"instParameters\" (\"size\")) (\"termOrder\" (\"IN\" \"OUT\" \"IB\"))))"

pin IN in -40 0
pin OUT out 40 0
pin IB in 0 40

param size 1

impl sch schematic

inst 0x0001 ./opamp
  at 0 0 R0
  name X1
  wn 2*size
  wp 4*size

# Feedback by name: the inverting input carries the output label.
label 0n0001 -40 20 R0 OUT

port 0p0001 -40 -20 R0 IN
port 0p0002 40 0 R0 OUT
port 0p0003 0 40 R0 IB
== bus_tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  doc "4-bit inverter array on buses"

inst 0x0001 ./inv
  at 0 0 R0
  name X[3:0]
  wn 0.5

wire 0w0001 -100 0 -40 0
  bus true
wire 0w0002 40 0 100 0
  bus true

label 0n0001 -100 0 R0 din[3:0]
label 0n0002 100 0 R0 dout[0:3]

== inv.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "CMOS inverter"
  category logic
  vsym c3b49cf0d0e520fe
  vsch cd3cd37f92abd912
  vcdf 5fd4f026a9d23b9e
  vcdfrec "(\"cdf\" \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"wn\" \"string\" \"1\" \"wn\" \"\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"wp\" \"string\" \"2\" \"wp\" \"\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"l\" \"string\" \"0.15\" \"l\" \"\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"auCdl\" ((\"instParameters\" (\"wn\" \"wp\" \"l\")) (\"namePrefix\" \"X\") (\"netlistProcedure\" \"ansCdlSubcktCall\") (\"termOrder\" (\"A\" \"Y\"))))"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"spectre\" ((\"instParameters\" (\"wn\" \"wp\" \"l\")) (\"termOrder\" (\"A\" \"Y\"))))"

pin A in -40 0
pin Y out 40 0

param wn 1
param wp 2
param l 0.15

impl sch schematic

line -40 0 -20 0
line 20 0 40 0

inst 0mn001 ./nmos
  at 0 60 R0
  name MN
  W wn
  L l
inst 0mp001 ./pmos
  at 0 -60 R0
  name MP
  W wp
  L l

# Drains joined by a vertical wire; the output wire T-joins it.
wire 0w0001 20 -30 20 30
wire 0w0002 20 0 60 0
# Gates joined; the input wire T-joins it.
wire 0w0003 -20 -60 -20 60
wire 0w0004 -60 0 -20 0

label 0n0001 20 -90 R0 vdd!
label 0n0002 20 -60 R0 vdd!
label 0n0003 20 90 R0 0
label 0n0004 20 60 R0 0

port 0p0001 -60 0 R0 A
port 0p0002 60 0 R0 Y

== nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "generic NMOS"
  category nmos
  prefix M
  vsym a453479a094a1448

pin D inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin S inout 20 30
pin B inout 20 0

param W 1
  unit um
  min 0.42
  grid 0.01
param L 0.15
  unit um
  min 0.15
  grid 0.01
param nf 1
  kind int
  min 1
param model nfet
  kind choice
  choices nfet nfet_lvt
param ad 0
  computed W*0.29

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W={W}u L={L}u nf={nf} ad={ad}p"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W={W}u L={L}u"
== opamp.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "two-stage Miller OTA, NMOS input pair"
  category amplifier
  vsym 4f91150cff1fc874
  vsch 68d6b1e2fdae041d
  vcdf 4f91150cff1fc874
  vcdfrec "(\"cdf\" \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"wn\" \"string\" \"2\" \"wn\" \"\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"wp\" \"string\" \"4\" \"wp\" \"\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"l\" \"string\" \"0.5\" \"l\" \"\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"cc\" \"string\" \"1p\" \"cc\" \"\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"auCdl\" ((\"instParameters\" (\"wn\" \"wp\" \"l\" \"cc\")) (\"namePrefix\" \"X\") (\"netlistProcedure\" \"ansCdlSubcktCall\") (\"termOrder\" (\"INP\" \"INN\" \"OUT\" \"IBIAS\"))))"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"spectre\" ((\"instParameters\" (\"wn\" \"wp\" \"l\" \"cc\")) (\"termOrder\" (\"INP\" \"INN\" \"OUT\" \"IBIAS\"))))"

pin INP in -40 -20
pin INN in -40 20
pin OUT out 40 0
pin IBIAS in 0 40

param wn 2
param wp 4
param l 0.5
param cc 1p

impl sch schematic

inst 0c0001 ./cap
  at 800 0 R0
  name CC
  C cc
# Devices at x = 0, 100, ..., all R0. NMOS pins: D (x+20,-30) G (x-20,0) S (x+20,30)
# B (x+20,0); PMOS: S (x+20,-30) G (x-20,0) D (x+20,30) B (x+20,0).
inst 0m0001 ./nmos
  at 0 0 R0
  name M1
  W wn
  L l
inst 0m0002 ./nmos
  at 100 0 R0
  name M2
  W wn
  L l
inst 0m0003 ./pmos
  at 200 0 R0
  name M3
  W wp
  L l
inst 0m0004 ./pmos
  at 300 0 R0
  name M4
  W wp
  L l
inst 0m0005 ./nmos
  at 400 0 R0
  name M5
  W wn*2
  L l
inst 0m0006 ./pmos
  at 500 0 R0
  name M6
  W wp*4
  L l
inst 0m0007 ./nmos
  at 600 0 R0
  name M7
  W wn*2
  L l
inst 0m0008 ./nmos
  at 700 0 R0
  name M8
  W wn
  L l

# Tail: the pair's sources share a wire.
wire 0w0001 20 30 120 30

label 0n0001 20 -30 R0 n1
label 0n0002 20 0 R0 0
label 0n0003 120 -30 R0 n2
label 0n0004 120 0 R0 0
label 0n0005 20 30 R0 tail
label 0n0006 220 -30 R0 vdd!
label 0n0007 180 0 R0 n1
label 0n0008 220 30 R0 n1
label 0n0009 220 0 R0 vdd!
label 0n0010 320 -30 R0 vdd!
label 0n0011 280 0 R0 n1
label 0n0012 320 30 R0 n2
label 0n0013 320 0 R0 vdd!
label 0n0014 420 -30 R0 tail
label 0n0015 380 0 R0 IBIAS
label 0n0016 420 30 R0 0
label 0n0017 420 0 R0 0
label 0n0018 520 -30 R0 vdd!
label 0n0019 480 0 R0 n2
label 0n0020 520 0 R0 vdd!
label 0n0021 620 -30 R0 OUT
label 0n0022 580 0 R0 IBIAS
label 0n0023 620 30 R0 0
label 0n0024 620 0 R0 0
label 0n0025 680 0 R0 IBIAS
label 0n0026 720 30 R0 0
label 0n0027 720 0 R0 0
label 0n0028 800 -20 R0 n2
label 0n0029 800 20 R0 OUT

port 0p0001 -20 0 R0 INP
port 0p0002 80 0 R0 INN
port 0p0003 520 30 R0 OUT
port 0p0004 720 -30 R0 IBIAS

== pmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "generic PMOS"
  category pmos
  prefix M
  vsym fbe369453d30f274

pin S inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin D inout 20 30
pin B inout 20 0

param W 2
  unit um
  min 0.42
  grid 0.01
param L 0.15
  unit um
  min 0.15
  grid 0.01
param model pfet
  kind choice
  choices pfet pfet_lvt

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W={W}u L={L}u"
== vsource.shprim

  doc "DC voltage source"
  prefix V
  vsym 57d847ef2df8d626
